title: whois: node.name and display_name not checked for null bytes
description: In kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs whois(), user_id and login_name are checked for null bytes (lines 349-356) but node.name and display_name are not. node.name flows into Identity.node_name and is used as a hostname string in peer delivery URL construction. A null byte in node_name could cause silent string truncation in C-backed libraries or SQL engines. The same risk applies to display_name if Tailscale ever sends a null byte there. Fix: add the same contains('\0') check for result.node.name and result.user_profile.display_name (if Some) before returning Ok.
